title: The Data Science Lifecycle
overview: This module contains 7 lessons from the PDF curriculum, retaining the original order and subtopics. Work through concepts, inspect examples, and document the evidence and limitations.
learning_outcomes: Explain the main concepts in The Data Science Lifecycle.
Apply a relevant technique to a small synthetic example and interpret the output.
Evaluate assumptions, edge cases, and limitations before communicating a conclusion.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 2: The Data Science Lifecycle; three key lesson cards and a four-step learning cycle.
overview_visual.caption: Overview of The Data Science Lifecycle with entry, application, and validation checkpoints.

status_note: Draft course content generated against the source PDF; review examples, assessment wording, and technical details before publication.
